title: Compose skill step 1 still reads the task from an empty Arguments line
body: What happened: in 0.9.0 the compose skill step 1 still says to read the task from the arguments (the last line of the skill). That last line is the empty text 'Arguments:'. Report R-a30e-0004 was marked fixed in 0.9.0, but the empty placeholder is still there. Expected: step 1 should not point to an empty line; with no id it should go straight to the No task id section. Steps: run /warden:compose with no argument and read the end of the loaded text. Evidence: loaded text ends with 'Arguments:' and nothing after it; step 1 starts 'Read the task from the arguments (the last line of this skill) and the user request'.
